JobDescription: Menya amakuru agezweho y’akazi mu Rwanda no mu mahanga. Dusangiza buri munsi imyanya y’akazi mu nzego za leta, imiryango itegamiye kuri leta (NGO), ibigo byigenga, amahugurwa ndetse n’buruse. Guma ku isonga mu rugendo rwawe rw’umwuga.
trafficDescription: Dutanga amasomo arambuye ku mategeko y’umuhanda n’umutekano wo mu muhanda. Menya amategeko agenga gutwara ibinyabiziga, ibimenyetso by’umuhanda, n’uko waba umushoferi w’umwizerwa.
testDescription: Kurikirana ibikorwa byose by’ibizamini bya provisoire biri kuba uyu munsi — amakuru yihuse, asobanutse kandi yizewe. Ntuzigere ucikwa n’amakuru ajyanye n’ibizamini byo gutwara.
aboutLine1: ThinkFaster ni urubuga rutanga amasomo yo kwiga ikoranabuhanga mu buryo bwimbitse kandi bushimishije.
aboutLine2: Dutanga amasomo arimo ibikorwa ndetse n'ibizamini bigufasha kwiga neza kandi wihuta.
missionLine1: Gutuma amasomo y’ikoranabuhanga aboneka kuri bose kandi yoroheye buri wese.
missionLine2: Intego yacu ni ugufasha abantu kubona ubumenyi binyuze mu kwiga bifatika.
